short_description: Priority visual and numerical proving ground for observing accepted ecology behavior before porting the same provider/presentation boundaries into the simulator.
purpose: Make ecology behavior inspectable in space and accelerated time through a bounded causal landscape, PH5-derived vegetation presentation, numerical diagnostics, overlays, repeatable disturbances and same-seed replay.
current_stage: ECO.VIS1.0 / Bounded Lab Scene + Operator Camera
progress_note: VIS1.0 is implemented as an isolated 500x500m deterministic lab terrain with fly camera, bounds/ground clamping, reference markers and coordinate/ground-height HUD. Exact attached Linux Godot 4.7.1 double parser + headless scene smoke passed 21 assertions. No production runtime/ecology truth changed. Windows automated and human graphical checks remain required before VIS1.0 acceptance.
last_accepted_checkpoint: ECO P4 branch lifecycle evidence complete; PH5 multi-scale derived presentation accepted
next_stage: Run VIS1.0 exact-Windows automated gate and human graphical observation. On PASS, freeze VIS1.0 and begin VIS1.1 EcoEnvironmentProvider + LabEnvironmentProvider.

ownership_claims.scope: Ecology semantics and derived laboratory diagnostics/presentation only.

planned_cross_tracks.goal: Causal landscape experiment with richer fields/history
Replace lab provider with real simulator surface provider
Production convergence after visual/numerical model validation
